mia (docs): Opening a small PR to refresh the model catalog cards: add quantized rows, clarify context vs runtime limits, include SDK snippets and migration guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4931

leo (ml): I can provide accuracy/throughput summaries. Quick notes: phi-3-7b-float -> trained 32k, runtime-accepted 32k; phi-3-7b-q4_1 -> 32k accepted, best latency on a100-80gb ~8.4 tok/ms at batch=1. I'll upload raw CSV to s3 and link it.

ash (eng): Heads-up: Private/Dedicated customers with agent image < rwinf-2024.12 will fail to load q5 artifacts. Add migration snippet: ``rwctl agents upgrade --image=redwood/runtime:rwinf-2024.12``. Note: rolling upgrade preserves sessions but KV cache flush required for shard swaps. Also add a KV cache per-shard limit: 48GB.

zoe (product): Please include a one-line "recommended for" on each card (e.g., "low-latency chat", "batch scoring"). Keep public benchmarks rounded; exact CSV only in expandable deep-dive.

mia (docs): Can someone paste minimal python and curl examples (streaming + non-streaming)? I'll include them in examples/ and add a tiny smoke test.

leo (ml): Python non-stream:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
r = c.generate(model='phi-3-7b-q4_1', input='Summarize AI infra tradeoffs', max_tokens=80)
print(r.text)
```
Streaming (py):
```
for chunk in c.stream_generate(model='phi-3-7b-q4_1', input='Write a haiku', max_tokens=32):
  print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"phi-3-7b-q4_1","input":"Hello","max_tokens":20}'
```

mia (docs): Perfect — I'll add those and a short example test under docs/examples/smoke/ that asserts response.text non-empty. Also fixing two broken links flagged by link-bot.

link-bot: [auto] link-check: found broken vendor link on phi-3 card; suggested replacement: https://vendor.example/phi-3/info

ash (eng): Also add a compatibility table column: "runtime-supported behavior" vs "trained context". E.g., Llama3-8B trained 16k, runtime accepts 32k (soft-truncate after 20k).

zoe (product): Add Known Issues bullet for experimental variants (q5_1). Mark q5_1 as "lab-tested" and not eligible for auto-quantize without approval.

mia (docs): Great. I'll push updates to PR #4931 in ~20m, include benchmark S3 links, migration snippet, examples, and compatibility table. Please review once CI passes. Thanks! :sparkles:
